program.mission: self.root v0.1 server-binary on accepted Hostinger Ubuntu VPS

coordination.selected_reason: V16 token ingress exposed a measured response-replay gap with no observed active implementation lane; response replay is separable from effect authority and network/TLS.

hypothesis: A one-final-response-per-durable-request V16.1 sidecar bound to exact V16 request key, execution id, lease epoch, HTTP metadata and response digest can reconstruct an admitted response across ingress-process restart without minting execution, effect, SELF, truth or learning authority.
strongest_counterhypothesis: Durable request admission is already sufficient and persisting a response adds storage/tamper complexity without reducing ambiguity; alternatively a replay store can silently splice a response across execution generations.

mechanism: prior durable V16 request admission required
SQL insert trigger rejects cross-generation replay splice
one immutable response row per request key
content SHA-256 plus domain-separated replay binding SHA-256
ClayCode contract states replay cannot mint authority
claim_limits: deterministic JSON serializer is not claimed as full RFC 8785 JCS
digest catches uncoordinated corruption but is not authentication against a privileged writer able to replace payload and digest
core response-replay adapter is not yet integrated

external_primary_evidence.use: Bearer-token transport requires TLS; do not close production ingress with plaintext HTTP.
Automatic retry of non-idempotent requests needs known idempotent semantics; motivates exact durable request/replay binding.
Canonical representations are useful for stable JSON hashing; candidate keeps a narrower deterministic-serialization claim.
Builtin http.server is not recommended for production.
Candidate next transport architecture: mature TLS terminator/reverse proxy before a local application server.
Self-hosted production guidance favors a process-managed app server behind a mature proxy rather than a toy builtin HTTP server.

normal: restart request does not spawn second execution

go_out_of_box_experiment.design: On disposable test state only, bypass the SQL no-update trigger and alter only response JSON while leaving its stored digest/binding unchanged. SQLite structural integrity is expected to remain green; application replay must fail closed on digest mismatch.
go_out_of_box_experiment.purpose: Discriminate structural database integrity from semantic replay integrity.
go_out_of_box_experiment.rollback: Disposable temporary database is destroyed after the test.

architecture_delta.change: Add V16.1 response-replay continuity beneath F-V01-08, separate from V15/V16 execution authority and F-V01-09 effect authority.
architecture_delta.next_transport_candidate: Production TLS terminator/reverse proxy plus a local bounded application server; Caddy and Uvicorn are current primary-doc reference candidates, not yet selected or installed.
